packageRules.description: The quic-go fork is pinned to a commit of a -mod-rename branch. Its tags declare the upstream module path, so go get fails on a tag. Update by hand with go get github.com/apernet/quic-go@<version>-mod-rename.
gvisor is pinned to a commit of its go branch. A digest update follows the master branch, and master does not build as a Go module.
